/**
 * Apply around every EXISTING Falco Worker, at its original URL.
 * This guard runs before /chat, /health, OPTIONS or any existing handler.
 * A public proxy in front of an unguarded original Worker is not sufficient.
 */
export function withMovensAuth(worker, profile) {
  if (!["clients", "admin", "employees"].includes(profile)) throw new Error("Invalid Falco profile");
  return {
    ...worker,
    async fetch(request, env, executionContext) {
      const secret = env.FALCO_GATEWAY_SECRET;
      if (typeof secret !== "string" || secret.length < 32 || secret.length > 512
          || !/^[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]+=*$/.test(secret)) return denied(503);
      const header = request.headers.get("Authorization") ?? "";
      if (header.length > 4096 || request.headers.get("X-Falco-Profile") !== profile) return denied(401);
      // Compare fixed-length digests without an early exit on a differing byte.
      const encoder = new TextEncoder();
      const [expected, supplied] = await Promise.all([
        crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", encoder.encode(`Bearer ${secret}`)),
        crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", encoder.encode(header)),
      ]);
      const a = new Uint8Array(expected);
      const b = new Uint8Array(supplied);
      let difference = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) difference |= a[i] ^ b[i];
      if (difference !== 0) return denied(401);
      const headers = new Headers(request.headers);
      headers.delete("Authorization");
      headers.delete("Cookie");
      return worker.fetch(new Request(request, { headers }), env, executionContext);
    },
  };
}

function denied(status) {
  return Response.json({ error: status === 503 ? "gateway_not_configured" : "unauthorized" }, {
    status, headers: { "Cache-Control": "no-store" },
  });
}
